fieldValues.title: A minutes process is distributed as one file and repeats elsewhere
fieldValues.summary: srs package export gives one deterministic 131 KB file of 82 definitions; installed into an empty repository it ran a second real meeting and a fictional one with no other setup, and a slice of a finished meeting carries the package whole.
evidence: com.semanticops.minutes-0.1.0.srspkg: same sha256 on re-export with a fixed published-at
package install --bundle: 82 installed, repo validate 0 errors
slice export of a meeting container: packageCount 2
fieldValues.body: Evidence that shared definitions can be published and installed today. What does not travel in the package is the runner's nine conventions.
